description: `cli program save --help` says a new program is private and that save never changes visibility.

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli program save <SLUG> <FILE> [OPTIONS]

Save a new revision of a program; a new program is private. Visibility is never changed by save (use `cli program visibility`).

Arguments:
  SLUG                        Program slug owned by this account; OWNER/SLUG as `cli program list` prints it is accepted when OWNER is confirmed as you, and refused (exit 2) when it cannot be.
  FILE                        Program file, or - for standard input.

Options:
  --message TEXT              Revision message.
  --base COMMIT_ID            Expected current commit id; a newer revision yields SERVICE_WRITE_CONFLICT.
  --preview                   Print the planned request of a mutation and send nothing.
  --json                      Print one JSON result; the same as the global --output json.
  --help                      Show help for this command.

Examples:
  prose cli program save hello hello.prose.md --preview
  prose cli program save hello hello.prose.md --message 'First draft'

Output: openprose.service-operation/1 (--json).
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid invocation or configuration; 10 service or credential error; 24 interrupted.
